summary: Idaho State Board of Education supports retaining current E‑Rate categories and CIPA framework, emphasizing E‑Rate’s cost‑effectiveness and essential role in Idaho schools. The Idaho Board of Education urges the FCC to keep the E‑Rate program active, retain the existing CIPA framework, and not restrict dark‑fiber or self‑provisioned network construction. The comment opposes sunset and screen‑time conditioning, supports self‑provisioned dark fiber, and calls for local design and implementation support. The board supports maintaining current E‑Rate connectivity and CIPA safeguards, opposes broad screen‑time or parental opt‑out mandates, recommends retaining special construction funding where cost‑effective, and calls for consultant oversight and ECF sunset safeguards. Idaho State Board of Education supports retaining current CIPA framework and funding for self‑provisioned construction and dark fiber.
